# juliato.dev

> A developer portfolio by juliato, specializing in web development, 3D graphics, and AI projects.

## About
juliato is a developer focused on building modern web applications, interactive 3D experiences, and AI-powered tools. Skilled in full-stack development with a strong focus on frontend technologies and creative coding.

## Projects

### CryptoHub Malta
A comprehensive crypto community website designed from scratch in Figma and built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Features community information, event listings, and resources for crypto enthusiasts in Malta.
- URL: https://cryptohubmalta.org
- Tech: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Figma

### Sip & Grow Website
A modern business website built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript. Features responsive design, component-based architecture, and integrated interactive browser games.
- URL: https://www.sipandgrow.org
- Tech: Next.js, React, TypeScript

### 2D Browser Game
A fun 2D browser game built with JavaScript and HTML Canvas API. Features game loops, sprite animations, collision detection, and user input handling. Integrated into the Sip & Grow website.
- URL: https://www.sipandgrow.org/game
- Tech: JavaScript, Canvas API

### 3D Browser Game
An immersive 3D browser game built with Three.js and WebGL. Features scene management, dynamic lighting, textures, and real-time rendering in the browser.
- URL: https://www.sipandgrow.org/game3d
- Tech: Three.js, WebGL, JavaScript

## Blog

### Why Innovating is Great (February 2026)
Innovation isn't reserved for billion-dollar labs. It's a mindset anyone can adopt. This post explores why building new things, experimenting, and pushing boundaries matters for developers and creators — and why the best time to start is now.
- URL: https://juliato.dev/blog/why-innovating-is-great
